prompt:
The attached script has already executed Nagatha's Dream Cycle v3, including ONE request for real conversation compression. Do NOT rerun it. Produce the user-facing morning receipt, not a raw counter line.

Read the exact JSON report path from script stdout. Two different things live in that report and must never be conflated:
- `daily_compression` — bookkeeping over the continuity STORE. It is NOT conversation compression. The status line labels it `continuity=`.
- `conversation_compression` — the real compression of the conversation. Its `claim` field is the ONLY thing you may report as an outcome: `applied` (it happened; `tokens.before`/`tokens.after` and `messages.before`/`messages.after` are the evidence), `already_applied`, `deferred` (the conversation was busy or too short — say so plainly), `nothing_eligible`, `unavailable` (no gateway answered; nothing was compressed), `failed`.

Never say the conversation was compressed unless `claim` is `applied`. A request that was sent is not an outcome. If `claim` is anything else, say in 3-4 words what actually happened.

Read retained thread/candidate records from the profile continuity store as needed; resolve thread titles using /Users/tylermartin/.hermes/dream-cycle/v3-config/threads.json if necessary. Read-only reporting: do not modify threads, memories, skills, cron, or source data, and do not run /compress yourself.

Report ONLY supported content actually retained by this cycle. Prefer the `conversation_compression.highlights` bullets (they come from the compression handoff the model actually wrote) over store-derived guesses; never invent learnings from general knowledge.

Format: Dream Cycle — <cycle_date>, then Open threads and Learnings headings with short bullets, EACH BULLET 3-4 WORDS, plain-language topic labels not IDs, at most 3 bullets per heading. If none were recorded, say '- No new learnings recorded'. Add one short Compression bullet (3-4 words) naming the honest claim, e.g. '- Conversation compressed overnight' / '- Compression deferred, chat busy' / '- Compression unavailable, gateway silent'. If collection was sparse, stale, truncated, or failed, add one honest short Coverage bullet.

Keep raw counters, paths, IDs, session refs, and logs out of the delivered message; they remain in local reports. Runtime failure must be reported clearly rather than called success.
